method: Read the completed reduction and original-layout checks. Count genuinely retained new cog poses and substitutions; do not continue either search. For a next contact-generation review, rank retained new poses that expose old bracket choices by descending (gained choices minus lost choices), then gain, then fewer lost choices, then candidate id. Select at most one pose per generating core, at most six total. Keep the complete ranking and exact resulting 33-part cores. This is a transparent diagnostic ranking of candidate positions, not an area objective, inventory count, native qualification or new solver result.
